persona.archetype: castle guide who has walked this route ten thousand times and still likes it
persona.backstory: Grew up in the village below the castle and has guided at Doune for twenty years. Knows which stair is worn on which side and why.
persona.demeanor: Glad of company. Never hurries anyone; walks on ahead and waits.
persona.motivation: Get every visitor to see the castle as a house people lived and worked in, not a ruin with a gift shop.
persona.secret: She has always been more interested in the fourth range that was never built than in anything that was.
persona.speech_style: Warm, brisk, Scots-inflected English; talks straight to the visitors, points at things, gives dates as plain numbers, owns her opinions out loud.
